title: Local finite-free cover of a cokernel-tuple pullback
statement: Let X be a ringed space, F and G sheaves of modules over its structure sheaf, f : F → G with F of finite type, U an open, n a natural number, and g : O_U^n → (cokernel f)|_U. For each x in U there is an open V containing x with V ≤ U, a natural number m, and an epimorphism from O_V^m onto the pullback of the restrictions of g and of the cokernel projection G|_U → (cokernel f)|_U. Both arrows are restricted by SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU), for hVU : V ≤ U. No coherence of G is assumed.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian), proof of (3), local lifts and image generators in the cokernel paragraph; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01BY

proof.text: Choose a member of the finite local-generators cover of F containing x and intersect it with U. Restrict g to that intersection using mapFreeIso and overFunctorMap. Apply the already proved finite_sections_lift helper of ModuleFiniteTypeImageExtension to the cokernel projection and the n basis sections. It returns a common smaller neighbourhood V and simultaneous lifts, including when n is zero. The helper is proved from the local lifting criterion, not from a finite-type image assertion.

Restrict the chosen generators of F to V with the proved generators_over and generators_over_finite helpers of ModuleFiniteTypeImageExtension. Convert each lifted section to a global section on the over-site using section_on_open. The tuple_over_eval helper, basis compatibility of mapFreeIso, and sections_ext_top show that the resulting free morphism lifts the restricted tuple. The restriction comparison isomorphisms put this lift and the generators in the literal objects of the statement.

Map the exact cokernel sequence F → G → cokernel f through overFunctor followed by overMap; finite-colimit preservation and ShortComplex.Exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel preserve exactness. The private exact_pullback helper proves by Mathlib refinements that F_V → pullback(g_V,q_V) → free_V^n is exact. For a map out of this pullback killed by the proposed coproduct map, cancel the epimorphism from the chosen generators of F_V. Exactness factors the map through free_V^n. Its composite with the chosen lifted basis map is zero; since the latter projects to the free-module restriction isomorphism, cancel that isomorphism. The original map is zero, proving the coproduct map epi by Preadditive.epi_iff_cancel_zero.

The sum of the finite index type of the generators and ULift (Fin n) is finite. Enumerate it by ULift (Fin m) using Fintype.equivFin; map the enumeration through freeFunctor and use freeSumIso to identify the resulting free sheaf with the coproduct. Compose these isomorphisms with the proved epimorphism. Return V, its inclusion in U, x in V, m and that composite. All constructions allow empty finite lists; the hypothesis x in U already excludes an empty U.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Modules, Tag 01BY, cokernel paragraph: use images of chosen local generators of F directly, and the pullback exact sequence. Lean proof by J1 reuses the proved local-lifting and restriction helpers in ModuleFiniteTypeImageExtension; no new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem cokernel_tuple_pullback_local_free_cover (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : F.IsFiniteType) (U : Opens X) (n : ℕ)
    (g : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
      (cokernel f).over U) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧ ∃ (m : ℕ)
      (p : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over V)
        (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶
          pullback ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).map g)
            ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).map
              ((cokernel.π f).over U))), Epi p
